title: Wilds of Eldraine: card flavor text

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A ruler who froze Loch Larent to create her ice palace, and whose icy kingdom spreads while she wears her crown; she felt compassion watching Ruby drag Kellan.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A tracker who would let neither thorns nor beasts stop her from finding her brother, Kellan.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young hero from a village who is dragged unconscious by Ruby, wields conjured light blades, and entered the fae court.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A witch who befriended the beasts of the wilds, made them more savage, and fell into the cauldron after Kellan slammed into her.

entities.name: Eulyn
entities.description: An Edgewall peddler.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: A town with a mayor and starving rats.

entities.name: Dunbarrow
entities.description: Home of witches and giant spiders.

entities.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
entities.description: A witch-queen whose throne room is filled with sleeping Ardenvale knights.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: A realm whose knights and citizens are caught in the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Goddric
entities.description: A figure who revealed his true identity and doused redcap invaders in dragonfire.

entities.name: Delverhaugh
entities.description: Site of the Grand Ball and a lavish feast.

entities.name: Redcaps
entities.description: Raiders who threatened the Grand Ball and fought dwarves.

entities.name: Neva
entities.description: A sleeper in the Wicked Slumber whose mind wandered the realm of dreams and was haunted by memories of the invasion.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A sleeping curse that saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp but continued to spread after the invasion ended.

entities.name: Syr Damon
entities.description: A knight of doves.

entities.name: Will, Scion of Peace
entities.description: A leader whose knights, hardened by the Phyrexian invasion, starved nightmares of fear.

entities.name: Rowan, Scion of War
entities.description: A character who wants to rebuild Eldraine with power rather than negotiate with her brother.

entities.name: High King Kenrith
entities.description: A High King whose armies followed him into the afterlife.

entities.name: Loch Larent
entities.description: A loch Hylda froze to create her palace.

entities.name: Sturwynn
entities.description: A Boundary Lands ranger.

entities.name: Ash
entities.description: A party crasher whose footsteps are heard after a helmet clatters to a stop.

entities.name: Valya
entities.description: An archmage mentioned by an unassuming sage.

entities.name: Beluna Grandsquall
entities.description: A giant who liberates valuables from the world below, keeps a vault, and has pets that escape Stormkeld.

entities.name: Stormkeld
entities.description: The realm of giants.

entities.name: Johann, Apprentice Sorcerer
entities.description: An apprentice sorcerer whose spells go awry.

entities.name: Yarvis
entities.description: A traveler led deeper into the forest by twinkling motes.

entities.name: Kylene
entities.description: A thief who stole a gem from giants to feed her family.

entities.name: Syr Lydel
entities.description: A knight of Vantress who will not return to the cold.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: Home of the knight Syr Lydel.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: A fae lord who gave Kellan empty hilts and invites guests to court.

entities.name: Obyra, Dreaming Duelist
entities.description: A High Fae princess and blademaster who sleepwalks through the wilds under the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker nightmare weaver connected to dying in sleep and to nightmares.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Invaders whose grasp Eldraine escaped via the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A prankster who laughs harder the louder his victims scream.

entities.name: Totentanz, Swarm Piper
entities.description: A swarm piper who found acceptance among rats and whose song summons doom.

entities.name: Sweettooth Village
entities.description: Home of sugary abominations.

entities.name: Greta, Scourge of Sweettooth
entities.description: A fighter against Sweettooth's candy creatures.

entities.name: Lord Skitter
entities.description: A rat lord who promised the starving rats of Edgewall they would never go hungry again.

entities.name: Gunrudd
entities.description: A figure referred to in a trick-shot challenge.

entities.name: Maurice
entities.description: A master blacksmith who accepted an invitation to a Delverhaugh feast.

entities.name: Thomas the woodsman
entities.description: A woodsman whose last words were 'My, what big paws y'.

entities.name: Imodane, the Pyrohammer
entities.description: A figure spoken of with the claim that the realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king.

entities.name: Troyan, Gutsy Explorer
entities.description: An explorer who guides Kellan and Ruby and who left Ravnica for Eldraine.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane Troyan found stifling.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane described as an endless adventure paved in gold.

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: A keep whose elves transform nightly into feral beasts and whose curse needs a rose to break.

entities.name: Yenna, Redtooth Regent
entities.description: Regent of Redtooth.

entities.name: Yorvo
entities.description: Owner of a pet that guards Beluna's vault.

entities.name: Verdant Order
entities.description: A newly formed order of knights who survived the invasion and swore to defend the wilds' untouched parts.

entities.name: Daniela
entities.description: An Edgewall youth following a candy trail.

entities.name: Alela
entities.description: Speaker of a line about stolen knowledge.

entities.name: Osval
entities.description: An adventurer.

entities.name: Tanglespan
entities.description: Home of fauns.

events.summary: Hylda watches Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious body through the cold and feels compassion for the first time in a long while.
events.quote: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.

events.summary: Goddric reveals his true identity and douses redcap invaders in dragonfire at the Grand Ball.
events.quote: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

events.summary: Neva's body lies protected while mages seek a cure for the Wicked Slumber.
events.quote: While Neva's mind wandered the realm of dreams, her body lay protected as mages worked frantically to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

events.summary: Kellan strikes on instinct and his conjured blades cleave through icy guardians.
events.quote: Kellan struck out on pure instinct, and his conjured blades cleaved through the icy guardians as though they were nothing but air.

events.summary: Hylda freezes Loch Larent to create her palace; some merfolk escape the chill and others do not.
events.quote: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill.

events.summary: Ash walks away as a helmet clatters to a stop and partygoers fall silent.
events.quote: As the helmet came to a clattering stop, the only sound was Ash's distant footsteps.

events.summary: Retellings of Agatha's demise make Kellan taller and Ruby stronger.
events.quote: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger.

events.summary: Kellan steps from his village into the fae court, where a voice asks if he is true of heart.
events.quote: Kellan stepped from his village into a strange world where trees bore jeweled fruit.

events.summary: Obyra's sleeping body slashes at her devoted servants.
events.quote: Obyra's devoted servants shrieked as their sleeping mistress slashed at them, unseeing.

events.summary: Kellan slams into Agatha and she falls screaming into the cauldron.
events.quote: Kellan heard Agatha howl when he slammed into her, heard her scream as she fell into the cauldron, but couldn't afford to think about the implications just yet.

events.summary: The Wicked Slumber saves Eldraine from Phyrexia but continues to spread after the invasion ends.
events.quote: The Wicked Slumber saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp, but instead of fading when the invasion ended, it continued to spread.

events.summary: Lord Skitter promises the starving rats of Edgewall they will never go hungry again.
events.quote: Lord Skitter promised the starving rats of Edgewall that they would never go hungry again.

events.summary: The mayor sends hounds to root out Lord Skitter, but they are bought off with bones.
events.quote: The mayor sent hounds to root out Lord Skitter, but their loyalty was easily bought with a handful of bones.

events.summary: Kellan's light blades form from empty hilts given by Talion despite Hylda's cold.
events.quote: something that poured into the empty hilts he'd been given by Talion and formed thorn-sharp blades of light

events.summary: Kellan and Ruby flee witchstalkers drawn to dark magic around an armored figure.
events.quote: Kellan and Ruby fled to the sound of savage howls and snapping jaws.

events.summary: Agatha befriends the beasts of the wilds, making them bolder and more savage.
events.quote: Agatha befriended the beasts of the wilds, and under her influence they grew bolder ... and more savage.

events.summary: Survivors of the invasion form the Verdant Order to defend the wilds.
events.quote: The newly formed Verdant Order has sworn to defend the last untouched parts of the wilds.

events.summary: Beluna habitually liberates valuables from the world below.
events.quote: Beluna makes a habit of "liberating" valuables from the world below, from priceless artifacts to historic buildings.

events.summary: Hylda's icy kingdom spreads and her heart grows colder as she wears the crown.
events.quote: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.

relations.quote: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.
